name: govuk-webmcp
description: Independent experimental WebMCP prototype for trusted government knowledge discovery

scripts.okf-federation:quality: npm run build && npm run okf-federation:quality:prepared
scripts.data:build: npm run sources:validate && npm run catalogue:build && npm run evidence:build && npm run federation:build && npm run okf-federation:build
scripts.build: npm run data:build && npm run data:validate && npm run dist:clean && tsc && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.python:setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --requirement requirements-dev.txt && .venv/bin/python -m pip check
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:prepared
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:prepared
scripts.test:browser:edge: npm run build && npm run test:browser:edge:prepared
scripts.test: npm run research:verify && npm run build && npm run test:unit:prepared && npm run test:browser:prepared
